name: Drawer
looksLike: panel that slides in from the side
menu that covers part of the screen
thing that opens when I tap the three lines
sliding sidebar with a dark overlay behind it
definition: A panel that slides in from the edge of the screen, usually holding navigation or actions, and sits on top of the page with a dimmed backdrop.
whenToUse: Filters or settings that shouldn't leave the current page

notConfusedWith.difference: Centered and blocks the page. Best for confirmations.
Small, anchored to a button, no backdrop.
Slides up from below. Mostly mobile.

prompts.short: Add a right-side drawer. Close on overlay click and Esc.
prompts.detailed: Add a right-side drawer (320px wide) with a dimmed backdrop and a slide-in animation. Trap focus inside it, close on Esc or backdrop click, return focus to the trigger on close, and mark it aria-modal.
